description:
Read state and pixels of one frame of the RUNNING game together: the live tree, property values and a screenshot stamped with the same frame numbers. The evidence read of a playtest.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/game-probe"}

instance.description: Game instance to address (default 'main' = the editor's embedded game).

max_dim.description: Longest image side in pixels, 16..4096 (default 1280); the frame is downscaled to fit.

props.description: Up to 64 '<absolute path>:<property>' keys read on the same frame, e.g. '/root/Main/Player:position'. Values come back as Godot literal strings; misses land in `missing`.

screenshot.description: Capture the game viewport (default true). false = state only, cheaper and works when the window draws nothing.

tree.description: Include the live scene tree ({name, class, path, children}) built game-side on the SAME frame as the pixels. Omit for no tree.

path.description: Subtree root, ABSOLUTE runtime path (default the scene tree root).

name: summer_game_probe
title: Probe the running game
